description: Soft-delete a document by id or name; still visible via host.docs.list {since} with deleted: true.

id.description: Document id to delete; use name instead if you don't have it.

name.description: Document name to delete; use id instead if you have it.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins. Omitting it on a connection with no header returns tenant_key_missing (-32602).

name: host.docs.delete
